purpose: Dated geopolitical decisions, legal commitments, capabilities, diplomacy, and civilian effects in historical context.

Present comparisons on equal terms and label illustrative scenarios.

Date and attribute contested territorial or causal claims; separate official position, documented action, and scholarly interpretation. Avoid forecasts and current operational advice.
